hcc-atezo-bev.text: IMbrave150: updated median overall survival 19.2 versus 13.4 months with sorafenib; HR 0.66.

hcc-stride.text: HIMALAYA: median overall survival 16.43 versus 13.77 months with sorafenib; HR 0.78. Progression-free survival was not significantly improved.

hcc-nivo-ipi.text: CheckMate 9DW: median overall survival 23.7 versus 20.6 months with lenvatinib or sorafenib; HR 0.79.

hcc-single-ici.text: RATIONALE-301 established overall-survival noninferiority of tislelizumab to sorafenib.
KEYNOTE-394 supported later-line pembrolizumab in an Asian population;
KEYNOTE-240 did not meet its prespecified statistical thresholds.

hcc-tki.text: REFLECT: lenvatinib was noninferior to sorafenib for overall survival (13.6 versus 12.3 months).

SHARP established sorafenib benefit over placebo (10.7 versus 7.9 months). Median OS 10.7 versus 7.9 months; HR 0.69 (0.55–0.87). Radiologic time to progression 5.5 versus 2.8 months, HR 0.58; this is not PFS. ORR 2% versus 1%, no complete responses.

hcc-adjuvant.text: IMbrave050 initially reported a recurrence-free survival advantage.
The 2026 update did not sustain that result: RFS HR 0.90 (95% CI 0.72–1.12); overall survival remained immature.

hcc-tace-combination.text: EMERALD-1, LEAP-012 and EMERALD-3 reported progression-free survival benefit for their respective combinations.
In EMERALD-3, STRIDE + lenvatinib + TACE yielded PFS 13.0 versus 9.8 months; overall-survival superiority was not established at the reported analysis.

btc-first.text: TOPAZ-1: overall-survival HR 0.80 for durvalumab + chemotherapy versus chemotherapy.
KEYNOTE-966: median overall survival 12.7 versus 10.9 months, HR 0.83, with pembrolizumab added.

btc-chemo-only.text: ABC-02 established cisplatin–gemcitabine over gemcitabine: median overall survival 11.7 versus 8.1 months; HR 0.64.

btc-folfox.text: ABC-06: FOLFOX + active symptom control versus active symptom control alone; median overall survival 6.2 versus 5.3 months, HR 0.69.

btc-adjuvant.text: BILCAP: primary intention-to-treat overall-survival comparison was not significant (HR 0.81; p=0.097); prespecified sensitivity and per-protocol analyses favored capecitabine.
ASCOT supported S-1 in a Japanese population.

cca-fgfr.text: FDA approval of lirafugratinib in September 2026 was based on REFOCUS: ORR 46%, median response duration 11.8 months.

cca-idh1.text: ClarIDHy: median PFS 2.7 versus 1.4 months, HR 0.37.
Final unadjusted overall survival was 10.3 versus 7.5 months, HR 0.79, with extensive crossover.

btc-her2-braf.text: HERIZON-BTC-01 supports zanidatamab activity in previously treated HER2-positive biliary cancer.
ROAR: investigator-assessed ORR 51% with dabrafenib + trametinib in 43 BRAF V600E-mutant biliary cancers.

pcca-protocol.text: The established transplant strategy combines protocol-directed neoadjuvant treatment, operative staging and transplantation. The V7 review keeps alternative chemotherapy or SBRT regimens as separate proposals.

icca-response.text: The V7 advanced-disease proposal uses sustained disease control and pure favorable-grade morphology, with one mass-forming focus ± adjacent satellites. Separate multifocal tumors are outside its initial cohort.

crlm-doublet.text: PARADIGM: left-sided RAS-wild-type disease had median OS 37.9 versus 34.3 months with panitumumab versus bevacizumab, both with mFOLFOX6.
FIRE-3 and CALGB/SWOG 80405 provide complementary, differently designed comparisons.

crlm-conversion.text: CAIRO5: FOLFOXIRI–bevacizumab improved PFS over doublet–bevacizumab in its right-sided or RAS/BRAF-mutant group (10.6 versus 9.0 months; HR 0.76), with greater toxicity.
TRICE studied cetuximab with triplet versus doublet chemotherapy in RAS/BRAF-wild-type CRLM.

crlm-msi.text: KEYNOTE-177: pembrolizumab PFS 16.5 versus 8.2 months with chemotherapy.
CheckMate 8HW established first-line PFS benefit of nivolumab–ipilimumab versus chemotherapy; its separate comparison versus nivolumab alone also favored the combination (HR 0.62).

crlm-braf.text: BREAKWATER: encorafenib–cetuximab + mFOLFOX6 improved PFS (12.8 versus 7.1 months) and OS (30.3 versus 15.1 months) over standard care.
BEACON established encorafenib–cetuximab-based treatment after prior therapy.

crlm-other-targets.text: MOUNTAINEER: ORR 38.1% in its combination cohorts.
CodeBreaK 300: PFS 5.6 versus 2.2 months with the approved-dose sotorasib combination versus standard care.

Tucatinib plus trastuzumab: confirmed ORR 39.3% (28.8–50.5), median response duration 15.2 months, PFS 8.1 months, OS 23.9 months. Grade 3 and 4 events 33.7% and 7.0%; 5.8% discontinued for adverse events.

crlm-later.text: NCCN Colon Cancer v2.2026, original PDF pages 46–51, organizes subsequent treatment by previous agents and molecular profile.

crlm-refractory.text: SUNLIGHT: OS 10.8 versus 7.5 months for trifluridine–tipiracil + bevacizumab versus trifluridine–tipiracil alone.
FRESCO-2 and CORRECT demonstrated survival benefit of fruquintinib and regorafenib, respectively, versus placebo.
OS 10.8 versus 7.5 months, HR 0.61 (0.49–0.77); PFS 5.6 versus 2.4 months, HR 0.44. ORR 6.1% versus 1.2%. Grade ≥3 events 72.4% versus 69.5%; neutropenia 43.1% versus 32.1%.

Fruquintinib versus placebo plus supportive care: OS 7.4 versus 4.8 months, HR 0.66 (0.55–0.80); PFS 3.7 versus 1.8, HR 0.32. Seven partial responses among 461; no complete response. Grade ≥3 events 63% versus 50%.

crlm-periop.text: EORTC 40983 showed PFS signals in eligible/resected analyses; its intention-to-treat PFS comparison and long-term OS comparison were not significant.
New EPOC found worse OS when cetuximab was added to perioperative chemotherapy.

net-ssa.text: PROMID: time to progression 14.3 versus 6 months with octreotide versus placebo in midgut NET.
CLARINET established PFS benefit with lanreotide in nonfunctional enteropancreatic NET, Ki-67 <10%.

net-prrt.text: NETTER-1: 20-month PFS 65.2% versus 10.8% with high-dose octreotide.
Final median OS 48.0 versus 36.3 months was not statistically significant (HR 0.84; p=0.30).

net-prrt-first.text: NETTER-2: median PFS 22.8 versus 8.5 months with 177Lu-DOTATATE + octreotide versus high-dose octreotide; HR 0.276.
The 2026 subgroup report supports activity across pancreatic/GI origin and G2/G3 subsets.

net-captem.text: E2211 randomized phase II: median PFS 22.7 versus 14.4 months with CAPTEM versus temozolomide at the scheduled interim analysis; final OS was not significantly different.

net-targeted.text: RADIANT-3: PFS 11.0 versus 4.6 months in pancreatic NET.
RADIANT-4: PFS 11.0 versus 3.9 months in nonfunctional GI/lung NET.
Sunitinib trial: PFS 11.4 versus 5.5 months in pancreatic NET.

net-cabo.text: CABINET: median PFS 13.8 versus 4.4 months in pancreatic NET and 8.4 versus 3.9 months in extrapancreatic NET, each compared with placebo.

net-emerging.text: OCLURANDOM was a randomized noncomparative phase II trial of 177Lu-DOTATATE with an internal sunitinib control.
COMPETE phase III found PFS 23.9 versus 14.1 months with 177Lu-edotreotide versus everolimus (HR 0.67).

net-nec.text: TOPIC-NEC: cisplatin–etoposide versus cisplatin–irinotecan did not differ significantly in OS (12.5 versus 10.9 months; HR 1.04).

v12-pdac-modified-folfirinox-adjuvant.text: PRODIGE 24 provides randomized survival evidence over gemcitabine in selected postoperative patients. It does not establish tolerability in every postoperative patient or prove neoadjuvant superiority.

v12-pdac-gemcitabine-capecitabine-or-sin.text: ESPAC-4 supports GemCap over gemcitabine; these are PDAC trials. Applying them to ampullary or mixed histology is extrapolation, not direct evidence.

v12-pdac-mfolfirinox-or-gemcitabine-nab-.text: A021501 supports a chemotherapy-first approach in its borderline-resectable setting but is not a definitive head-to-head proof against all radiation.
NORPACT-1 did not establish benefit of routine neoadjuvant FOLFIRINOX in resectable pancreatic-head cancer.

v12-pdac-paxg-selected-neoadjuvant-use.text: Median event-free survival 16.0 versus 10.2 months, HR 0.63 (0.47–0.84). EFS included confirmed CA19-9 rises and unresectability, not just progression/death. Resection 75% versus 67% (not significant); R0 rates similar. Grade ≥3 toxicity 66% versus 61%. OS immature; no established OS superiority.

v12-pdac-folfirinox-or-nalirifox-metasta.text: NAPOLI-3 showed NALIRIFOX OS 11.1 versus 9.2 months with gemcitabine-nab-paclitaxel; this does not compare NALIRIFOX directly with FOLFIRINOX.

v12-pdac-gemcitabine-nab-paclitaxel-meta.text: Avoid ranking it against FOLFIRINOX by comparing medians from different trials; NAPOLI-3 supplies a direct comparison only with NALIRIFOX.

v12-pdac-liposomal-irinotecan-fluorourac.text: nal-IRI plus 5-FU/LV: OS 6.1 versus 4.2 months, HR 0.67 (0.49–0.92); PFS 3.1 versus 1.5, HR 0.56. ORR 16% versus 1%. nal-IRI monotherapy did not improve OS (HR 0.99). Grade 3–4 neutropenia 27%, diarrhea 13%.

v12-pdac-daraxonrasib-current-us-option.text: RASolute 302 randomized previously treated patients: overall-population OS 13.2 versus 6.7 months, HR 0.40. That trial does not independently establish the same effect in treatment-naive frail patients included in the broader label.

v12-pdac-platinum-and-olaparib-maintenan.text: POLO improved PFS, not a demonstrated OS benefit.
PALB2-associated platinum sensitivity does not automatically confer the olaparib PDAC label. Germline and somatic findings are not interchangeable.

v12-pdac-zenocutuzumab-and-rare-molecula.text: Molecular selection does not justify using unvalidated combinations or every RAS inhibitor interchangeably. See shared biomarker section.

v12-ampullary-ampullary-intestinal-subty.text: ESPAC-3 periampullary did not meet its primary unadjusted OS endpoint.
Modern combinations are largely extrapolated from other GI cancers; the existing ampullary roadmap details this uncertainty.

v12-ampullary-ampullary-pancreatobiliary.text: These are largely pancreatic or biliary extrapolations, not ampullary-specific phase III comparisons. Document subtype, margin/nodal risk, molecular results and why a borrowed regimen fits.

v12-chcca-combined-hcc-cca-advanced-dise.text: Overall OS 8.9 months, PFS 2.8 months, ORR 5.6%. Pooled platinum regimens had longer observed OS than sorafenib; adjusted sorafenib-versus-platinum mortality HR 15.83 (2.25–111.43). All seven sorafenib exposures including later line had progression.

v12-chcca-combined-hcc-cca-after-resecti.text: Do not describe BILCAP, PRODIGE 24 or HCC adjuvant evidence as direct cHCC-CCA evidence. Record the uncertainty in the decision document.

v12-icca-liposomal-irinotecan-plus-fluor.text: PFS 2.6 versus 2.3 months, HR 0.87 (0.56–1.35); OS 6.9 versus 8.2 months, HR 1.08 (0.68–1.72). ORR 14% versus 4% did not translate into PFS/OS benefit. Grade ≥3 events 71% versus 50%; treatment-related serious events 33% versus 2%.

v12-nelm-folfiri-or-other-selected-salva.text: Later-line NEC evidence is limited; no universally superior sequence. Do not import PRRT or NET targeted-drug results into receptor-negative poorly differentiated NEC.
